transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess... things just started feeling kind of flat. Stuff I normally care about—taking photo walks, helping mentor the kids, even keeping my calendar together—it all started feeling heavy, and I stopped really starting any of it.
Did this start after a specific stressful event or major life change?

Yeah… kind of. It’s been about a year and three months, I think. It started after a family member’s health and behavior changed, and I had to take on more of the coordinating. That’s when things started to shift for me.
If that family situation suddenly improved, do you think your mood would mostly go back to normal?
I’m not sure. I’d like to think it would help, yeah… but I don’t know if everything would just go back to normal that quickly.
Have you been feeling this way most days for at least two years?
No… not two years. It’s been more like about a year and three months, since the family situation changed and I had to start coordinating more.
Before this started a year and three months ago, had you ever had another period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed or lost interest in things most days?
I… I don’t really know. Nothing that clearly lasted like that comes to mind.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?
I don’t know… I’ve had some low days, but saying most days feels hard to answer. I guess I haven’t really kept track.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… some. Things I usually care about, like going out for photography or mentoring the kids, even keeping my calendar organized… they’ve started feeling kind of flat. Heavy. I just don’t really start them like I used to.
Do your mood and motivation problems feel mainly centered on dealing with your family member’s situation?

Not really mainly that, no. It’s more… the regular things that make me feel like myself just started feeling flat. Photography walks, mentoring the kids, even keeping my calendar clean—I just stopped starting them.
During this past year, have you often felt sad or empty?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had times like that, I guess… but “often” is hard for me to say.
Have you been feeling tired or low on energy?

Yeah… kind of. It’s less like I’m physically exhausted all the time and more like things feel heavy. The stuff I usually start on my own—photography walks, mentoring, keeping my calendar straight—I just haven’t had the energy to initiate it.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed nearly every day?
I don’t know if I’d say nearly every day. Some days feel pretty low, but I haven’t really been tracking it like that.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d say most of the day nearly every day. I’ve had some down stretches, but… I don’t know if it’s been that constant.
Have you been worrying a lot on most days?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say a lot, exactly. I worry about things sometimes, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether it’s most days.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah… a little. Work’s mostly been okay, but I’ve been missing calendar details and having to double-check things I used to just do automatically. I’ve also kind of pulled back from photography stuff and mentoring because I don’t feel as present or dependable.
Did these changes in mood and motivation begin after you developed a new medical or neurological problem?
Not that I’ve noticed. I don’t think there was some new medical thing that started it… at least, nothing I can point to.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about different parts of your life on most days?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I worry about things here and there, but I don’t know that it’s excessive or most days.
Was there ever a stretch of at least two weeks when you had little or no interest in nearly all the things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I think so. It’s been more like the things that usually make me feel like me—photography walks, mentoring the kids, even staying on top of my calendar—started feeling flat and heavy. I just… stopped starting them.
During the same two-week stretch when you lost interest in almost everything, did you also feel depressed most days?
I’m not sure I’d call it depressed most days. I was… low, I guess, but it’s hard for me to separate that from just not caring about things.
Have you had a noticeable change in your sleep?

Yeah… some nights it’s different. I’ll sleep maybe two or three hours, wake up really early, and then I’m just up—like I could start answering emails or fixing appointment lists. I don’t always feel tired when it happens.
When you wake after only two or three hours of sleep, do you feel unusually energized or more up than your normal self?

Yeah… on those nights, I do feel more ready to go than I probably should. Like I’ll wake up before dawn after two or three hours and think I can start answering emails or fixing the appointment lists, not really tired.
